title: Returns & Refunds
body:
This page explains how returns and refunds work. Your statutory rights as a UK consumer are not affected.

### Changing your mind
Under the Consumer Contracts Regulations, when you buy at a distance (for example by message) you normally have 14 days from the day you receive your item to tell us you want to cancel, and a further 14 days to send it back. Items must be returned in the condition you received them.

[[TO COMPLETE: who pays return postage, and the address or process for returns]]

### Faulty or incorrect items
If an item is faulty, damaged or not as described, message us within [[TO COMPLETE: e.g. 48 hours]] of delivery with photos and your order details. Your rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 apply.

### Refunds
Refunds are made to the original payment method within 14 days of us receiving the returned item. [[TO COMPLETE: confirm payment methods you accept]]
